tableVerbalization.description: LLM-readable string version of the data in the table.

dataFrameFile.description: CSV version of the data frame of the table. Used for display purposes of the table

tableImageFile.description: Url of the cropped table image (useful for facilitaing LLM answering in REA pipeline)

imageVerbalization.description: LLM-readable string version of the data in the image.

source.description: The source from which this passage came.

intraSourceId.description: The id of this passage within its #source.

chunkingSpec.description: The chunking spec used to produce this passage from its #source.

contentStr.description: The content of the passage (the same as the description for vectorstore)

indexedContentStr.description:
The original content of the passage with the {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata}
added into it.

pageNumber.description:
The page number the content begins on.
Page number is only supported for PDFs currently.

sourceType.description: Whether it's a table, image or text source type of {@link Genai.SourcePassageTypeEnum}.

codemap.description:
A mapping of  of <string id>: <code snippet> for all code snippets contained within the original
passage that are extracted before indexing.

componentInfo.description:
Extra information for the associated text/image/table component,
such as bbox coordinates (original and scaled), page height/width, box class, etc.
Generated by mew3.

documentInfoFile.description:
A JSON file in FileSystem storing the source document information,
such as file format, dpi, parsing specs, etc.
Generated by mew3.

title: A SourcePassage is a passage of text, table, or image from a source file.
name: Genai.SourcePassage
